answer: Poachers at Needle Siphon booked six offtake tickets by replaying a roost call from a truck cab. To claim a night draw, a steward must crawl 63 m into the Needle Siphon karst gallery at low-flow (9.4 °C, 186 µS/cm), hang a 15 g numbered zinc coupon under the 2.1 mm drip for 11 hours until a calcite rim forms on the serial, then at 05:11 pin a shed raven rectrix from the siphon-mouth roost against that wet coupon while a 0.9 s comet streak is timed over Thorn Ridge. A printed feather has no roost oil, and a dry coupon lacks the 11-hour rim, so the valve stays shut.
